target.statement: GGDPC clustering on the Old Faithful geyser data (n=272) with Gaussian KDE, producing the four-panel figure (graph, waterfall, decision diagram, dendrogram) and the resulting cluster partition; the headline qualitative result is that GGDPC recovers the two eruption-duration clusters.
target.dataset: Old Faithful Geyser data (Azzalini and Bowman 1990), n=272, 2D

compute.basis: The target is a 272-point 2D clustering with KDE and 1NN searches; the repository likely provides the implementation, and the dataset is built into R/Python, so a clean re-run is minutes of CPU work.
